# Document header input and result semantics before scanner details

A useful new manual comment rule for this parser is to state NUL-delimited input, ownership and whether the returned length includes the terminator. Keep implementation steps in nearby method comments. Post-landing review asked for explicit empty-Span construction and for implementation details to move out of function documentation. Current code still assigns nullptr to the Span and still names m_remainingHeaders in that comment, so those cleanup requests were not adopted in the checked source. The proposal is supported by the review and the actual caller contract; it is not presented as fully consistent existing style.

Scope: C++ contract comments and proposed cleanup.
